# Original Xbox

Every app in this list that runs on Original Xbox. That is 3 apps with 1 for Plex and 3 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [Butter and Jelly](https://github.com/MrMilenko/ButterAndJelly) - App for classic game consoles. `Jellyfin` · `macOS` `Xbox 360` `Original Xbox` `Wii U` · `GPL-2.0` `Free`
- [JellyBox (faithvoid)](https://github.com/faithvoid/script.jellybox) - XBMC4Xbox script for the original Xbox. `Jellyfin` · `Original Xbox` · `Open source` `Free` `Stale 2025`
- [PSPStreamer](https://github.com/dreimer1986/PSPStreamer) - Sony PSP player backed by a transcoding server, with watch-status sync and MilkDrop visualisers. `Plex` `Jellyfin` · `Original Xbox` `PSP` · `GPL-2.0`
